simple.meaning: חַטָּא (chaṭṭâʼ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a criminal , or one accounted guilty.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 19 times across Genesis, Numbers, 1 Samuel, 1 Kings, Psalms, and 3 more, beginning at Genesis 13:13. Its contexts include family, family line, kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חַטָּא (H2400).

definitions.short: a criminal , or one accounted guilty
definitions.full: H2400. chatta [ חַטָּא ] adjective and noun masculine 1 sinful , 2 sinners — as feminine adjective חַטָּאָה Amos 9:8 , elsewhere only plural חַטָּאִים Num 32:14-15 t.; construct חַטָּאֵי Amos 9:10 ; suffix חַטָּאֶיהָ Isa 13:9 ; — 1. adjective a. sinful men Num 32:14 (J), kingdom Amos 9:8 . b. exposed to condemnation, reckoned as offenders 1Kin 1:21 (compare Hiph`il Participle Isa 29:21 ). Elsewhere 2. noun masculine sinners Num 17:3 (P), 1Sam 15:18 ; Amos 9:10 ; Isa 1:28 ; 13:9 ; Psa 1:1 , 5 ; 25:8 ; 26:9 ; 51:15 ; 104:35 ; Prov 1:10 ; 13:21 ; 23:17 ; ׳ח ליהוה sinners against ׳י Gen 13:13 (J).

occurrences.englishText: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against Yahweh.
You shall write Aaron’s name on Levi’s rod. There shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.
“Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of Yahweh toward Israel.
and Yahweh sent you on a journey, and said, ‘Go, and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they are consumed.’
Otherwise it will happen, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be considered criminals.”
Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked,
Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment,
Don’t gather my soul with sinners,
Let sinners be consumed out of the earth.
My son, if sinners entice you,
Don’t let your heart envy sinners,
But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together,
Behold, the day of Yahweh comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.
The sinners in Zion are afraid.
Behold, the eyes of the Lord Yahweh are on the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the surface of the earth; except that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob,” says Yahweh.
All the sinners of my people will die by the sword, who say, ‘Evil won’t overtake nor meet us.’
